title: FJ45 Steady Move
style: Progressive house with driving four-on-the-floor kicks, rolling offbeat bass, and bright chord lifts; verse rides on sparse percussion and chopped vocal phrases, pre-chorus opens with rising filters and snare climbs, chorus blooms with wide supersaw pads and a vocal lead doubled in octaves. Airy risers, reverse cymbal swells, and a late-drop piano motif bridge the sections. Crisp, glossy, festival-ready mix with punchy low end and shimmering highs, steady, rapid, clean
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
FJ45, sitting where it stands
Rapid decay moving, need a pair of steady hands
No need for the plastic, no need for the stall
Just a mechanical look, answering the call
Tyler gets the quote, Tyler sees the view
How to keep the Cruiser moving, what we gotta do
Suggestion is the method, treat the ride with care
Doctor’s on the way, see what we can repair

[Pre-Chorus]
Friday at 2, on the site
Checking out the Cruiser, setting it right
No demands made, just a path to choose
Fix the FJ now, nothing left to lose

[Chorus]
Friday at 2, Ricardo on the site
Checking out the Cruiser, setting it right
No demands made, just a path to choose
Fix the FJ now, nothing left to lose
Steady move forward, keeping it clean
The Doctor’s in the yard, working the machine
Tyler hear the quote, see the road ahead
Keep the Cruiser moving, like the plan said

[Verse 2]
Counting up the beans, maybe it’s a cost
But the time on the road is what is really lost
Treated like my own, I pass it on to you
Suggestions on the table, whatever you wanna do
Free to choose the path, free to let it ride
But the decay is moving, can’t keep it inside
Friday at 2, the inspection takes place
One clear direction, keeping up the pace

[Pre-Chorus]
Friday at 2, on the site
Checking out the Cruiser, setting it right
No demands made, just a path to choose
Fix the FJ now, nothing left to lose

[Chorus]
Friday at 2, Ricardo on the site
Checking out the Cruiser, setting it right
No demands made, just a path to choose
Fix the FJ now, nothing left to lose
Steady move forward, keeping it clean
The Doctor’s in the yard, working the machine
Tyler hear the quote, see the road ahead
Keep the Cruiser moving, like the plan said

[Bridge]
Friday at 2, the room goes wide
One clear decision, keep it alive
Little by little, back to the road
Heavy on the worry, light on the load

[Final Chorus]
Friday at 2, Ricardo on the site
Checking out the Cruiser, setting it right
No demands made, just a path to choose
Fix the FJ now, nothing left to lose
Steady move forward, keeping it clean
The Doctor’s in the yard, working the machine
Tyler hear the quote, see the road ahead
Keep the Cruiser moving, like the plan said
